profile.label: glm53-flash-exl3-1m

model.quantization: exl3-4bit routed experts; q4 dense; fp8 KV

container.name: tensorfold-glm53-flash-exl3-1m
container.gpus: all 4 NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3; one rank per GPU

platform_notes: The published recipe image is linux/arm64; this host runs a locally built linux/amd64 image from the same TensorFold v0.6.0 + patches.
start.sh targets 2-3 DGX Sparks over SSH/RoCE; this host runs one container with four ranks, one GPU each, all GPUs visible for NCCL/NVLink.
The NGC image sets NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=spcx (Spectrum-X); this non-RDMA host requires NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none and NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0.
TensorFold's GLM engine hardcodes cuda:0; the container entrypoint patches it to honor TF_GLM_DEVICE per rank.
profile.qualification: Interface smoke (chat, reasoning, tool call, vision) passed. Capacity/decode/retrieval screens are recorded in docs/GLM53_RESULTS.md. Not a sustained-load or production-tail qualification.

# Technical Analysis of Plant Condition Monitoring Records

## 1. Scope and Data Summary

This report analyzes 18 condition-monitoring records from a multi-unit industrial facility. Each record contains five measured parameters: pressure (kPa), temperature (°C), flow (m³/h), vibration (mm/s RMS), and efficiency (%). Equipment types represented include reactors, turbines, pipelines, valves, scrubbers, compressors, and heat exchangers.

**Dataset overview:**

| Parameter | Min | Max | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pressure | 93 kPa | 887 kPa | Wide spread; compressor 7506 and pipeline 1289 are outliers |
| Temperature | −14 °C | 177 °C | Several sub-zero readings suggest cryogenic or chilled service |
| Flow | 92 m³/h | 874 m³/h | Low flows may indicate throttling or fouling |
| Vibration | 0.7 mm/s | 8.8 mm/s | Several units approach or exceed ISO 10816 alarm thresholds |
| Efficiency | 72% | 98% | Compressors and scrubbers show the weakest performance |

# Technical Analysis of Plant Records: Failure Modes, Key Measurements, and Maintenance Actions

## 1. Scope and Method

This report analyzes 18 records (0000000–0000017) covering seven asset classes — turbines, condensers, reactors, compressors, pipelines, valves, and separators — across stations ranging from 43 to 390. Each record contains five process/condition parameters: pressure (kPa), temperature (°C), flow (m³/h), vibration (mm/s RMS), and efficiency (%).

Because the records are a heterogeneous snapshot (no timestamps, no unit-specific baselines, no trend history), the analysis proceeds by:

1. **Screening each record against plausible operating envelopes** for its asset class.
2. **Identifying physically inconsistent parameter combinations** (e.g., high temperature with low pressure, or high vibration with high efficiency), which are the strongest indicators of sensor faults, data-quality problems, or genuine abnormal operation.
3. **Ranking findings by risk** and assigning concrete maintenance actions.

Vibration is interpreted against the widely used ISO 10816/20816 framework for rotating machinery: **< 2.8 mm/s** is Zone A/B (acceptable), **2.8–7.1

# Technical Analysis of Plant Condition Monitoring Records

## 1. Scope and Data Overview

This report analyzes 18 condition-monitoring records (0000000–0000017) covering six asset classes — pipeline, pump, turbine, valve, reactor, separator, and heat exchanger — across 17 stations. Each record contains five measured parameters:

- **Pressure** (kPa): 98 – 849 kPa
- **Temperature** (°C): −14 – 175 °C
- **Flow** (m³/h): 205 – 870 m³/h
- **Vibration** (mm/s RMS): 0.6 – 8.0 mm/s
- **Efficiency** (%): 73 – 98 %

Because the records are heterogeneous (different asset types and stations), the analysis below is structured in three parts: (1) a fleet-wide screening against typical alarm thresholds, (2) asset-by-asset interpretation of likely failure modes, and (3) a prioritized maintenance action plan.

# Technical Analysis of Plant Equipment Records — Stations 3–368

## 1. Scope and Data Summary

This report analyzes 18 equipment records spanning eight asset classes (scrubbers, valves, separators, condensers, heat exchangers, a turbine, and a compressor) across stations 3 through 368. Each record includes five process measurements: pressure (kPa), temperature (°C), flow (m³/h), vibration (mm/s RMS), and efficiency (%).

**Dataset overview:**

| Parameter | Min | Max | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pressure | 82 kPa | 865 kPa | Wide spread; low-pressure outliers at records 0000008, 0000012 |
| Temperature | −20 °C | 177 °C | Sub-zero readings suggest cryogenic or ambient-exposed service |
| Flow | 161 m³/h | 894 m³/h | ~5.5× range across units |
| Vibration | 0.1 mm/s | 8.7 mm/s | Several units exceed typical ISO 10816 alarm thresholds |
| Efficiency | 70% | 96% | Multiple units below 75% warrant investigation |
